candidates.change_summary: Delete the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll performs no withdrawal.
Replace withdrawal of the full balance with a withdrawal of 0 wei.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can withdraw the full balance.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw(uint) sends nothing to the caller.
Replace transfer(msg.sender) with transfer(address(this).balance) so the entire contract balance is sent instead of _value.
Replace transfer(msg.sender) with transfer(address(owner)) so funds go to the stored owner rather than the caller.
Replace transfer(_value) with transfer(1) so a fixed amount of 1 wei is transferred regardless of the requested value.
Delete the require check so the onlyOwner modifier no longer restricts callers, allowing anyone to invoke withdraw.
